decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core drainage range in a growing industry, this black-finish line fits the firm's design-led strategy and there is no clear evidence that would justify reversing the investment so soon after launch.
This shower channel was given its own page, showing visible commitment, and its strong fit with the firm's established shower drainage business makes management likely to continue backing it.
